title: December, 2013
logline: Does Chloe come home. A card, printed. And inside it, folded, handwritten: the invitation, early. July. She wrote 'come' four times.

panels.composition: The garage. A glossy card. Inside, a folded sheet, cream, handwritten. WOOD unfolding it. BARNABY asleep, always asleep now.

image.prompt: a man at a garage drafting table unfolding a handwritten cream note from inside a glossy printed card, an old dog asleep in a bed, clean ink

panels.composition: The note, her capitals: 'W — The real invitation comes in April. This is the real one. July 19. The islands. Come. Come. I mean it, come. Bring the dog if he can. Come. — C.'

image.prompt: a panel that is a handwritten note in tiny cramped capitals on cream paper, one word repeated

panels.composition: Wood counting on his fingers. Four.

image.prompt: a man holding up four fingers and looking at them

panels.composition: The note on the corkboard, writing-out. Three now that show their words. Beside it the bus schedule from 1999, yellow. The strip lets the reader do the math.

image.prompt: a crowded corkboard where a man pins a handwritten note writing-side out beside a yellowed old bus schedule, two other notes pinned the same way, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: 'Come' four times. Pinned beside the 1999 bus schedule.
